sentences.en: The startup was self-funded by the founders.
sentences.zh: 这家初创公司是由创始人自筹资金成立的。

sentences.en: Many small businesses are self-funded and don't take loans.
sentences.zh: 许多小企业都是自筹资金，不贷款。

sentences.en: The project was self-funded, relying on internal resources only.
sentences.zh: 这个项目是自筹资金的，仅依靠内部资源。

senses.zh: 自筹款项的，自筹资金的
